problem: Windows notification capability probing can initialize a shared Start Menu shortcut and COM activator, despite the manual shortcut guard.
change: Only packaged default Windows profiles may use shared shell registration and native notifications. Explicit --user-data-dir and development runs skip identity/shortcut registration and never probe or construct native notifications. Direct send attempts fail without claiming submission.

userVisibleBehavior.macOSAndLinux: Existing notification branch retained; tested with platform mocks only.

preservation.comparisonMeaning: Equality of the recorded before/after snapshots only; not continuous monitoring and not a full profile inventory.
